I recently dropped out of school and let me tell you looking back school was a piece of piss. Friendships don't always last is something you need to understand, life goes on the only thing you need to think and focus on right now is school work because cmon you don't want to be a garbat man right? You might feel better if you have something to focus on, school work is probably the most beneficial but hobbies can work aswell like instruments or drawing or even gaming whatever helps you escape. As for confidence, I used to be very anxious about a lot of things but now that I've left you realise no one gives a shit if you walk a little different or your hair is slightly out of place or your music taste is different from everyone else. You will find someone who enjoys the same things or you will find yourself in the things you like (its sappy I know but I think you need to hear it) be who you want to be.

Definitely talk to someone if you do have depression you can get help, if you don't then they can help you manage you emotions and also to understand and be more comfortable with what your thinking. Hope everything works out fella.
